premises.text: Crowd connectivity can efficiently connect the next trillion things to the Internet
premises.evidence_span: we could leverage crowd connectivity to connect more efficiently, more cost-effectively the next trillion things to the Internet

premises.text: Participants in the network need to be rewarded for their contributions
premises.evidence_span: we could first make sure that everyone participating in the network would be rewarded

premises.text: A new economic model can reward participants based on the data they move
premises.evidence_span: the more data you move, the more value there is in the data you move, the more you earn another cash or cryptocurrency

premises.text: A secure communication protocol is necessary for IoT connectivity
premises.evidence_span: we created a communication protocol that has security built in

premises.text: Blockchain technology can enhance the security and scalability of IoT networks
premises.evidence_span: Rendezvous is amazing. It is built on blockchain. It is a fully decentralized technology

premises.text: Nodal provides a 100% software solution for IoT connectivity
premises.evidence_span: Nodal is the only solution which is 100% software, and that addresses all the use cases in Industry 4.0

value.text: Individuals can reclaim ownership of their data and earn rewards for contributing to a secure Internet
value.evidence_span: Nodal is the opportunity for you to be rewarded and earn Nodal Cash each time you help smart cities, companies, and businesses build a more secure and private Internet for connecting their things
